final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT b.link_to_event, e.status, AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(1.0 * (b.spent - b.amount) / b.amount) AS avg_ratio FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.status), step2 AS (SELECT status, AVG(avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM step1 GROUP BY status), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) AS overall_avg_remaining FROM step1) SELECT step2.status, step2.avg_remaining, step2.avg_ratio, step2.avg_remaining / step3.overall_avg_remaining AS avg_remaining_ratio FROM step2 JOIN step3 ON step3.overall_avg_remaining IS NOT NULL
